Internal-only comment cleanup (no behavior change): pruned comment cruft across the connector's Python and TypeScript sources. Removed the `# -----` / `// -----` rule-line section dividers and normalized the inline `# --- Label ---` dividers to plain `# Label` comments, plus a small number of comments that restated the adjacent code (e.g. `# Verify ownership`), correctness-argument comments (e.g. two `Defensive:` notes in the suspension gates), and one version-history comment in `r2/buckets.py` (trimmed to the latency rationale). The substantive "why" comments (invariants, cross-references, security and wire-compat notes) were left intact.
